text:
maya: Quick idea — propose a lightweight 'ownership signal grid' + a small IC schedule tweak to reduce handoff gaps. TL;DR: 1) 12-week ownership pulse for remediations, 2) 3-person handoff matrix (owner / fallback / escalation), 3) soft-standby IC for weekend coverage. Thoughts?

alex: Love the framing. Can you sketch the grid? thinking cols: owner, fallback, SLA (days), reminder cadence, status.

maya: Sketch below (very rough). Also want weekly pulse emails to owners for remediations past SLA and a monthly trend summary.

```
Ownership Signal Grid (cols):
- remediation-id: RMD-123
- owner: team/alex
- fallback: team/sanjay
- SLA (days): 14
- reminder cadence: 7d/3d/1d before due
- status: in-progress / blocked / done
- blockers: (external team / ticket link)
```

sanjay: I like the grid. About weekend standby IC — we should avoid hard rotation that burns people. Proposal: 'soft standby' model where a named IC is reachable but only paged after secondary checks, and we rotate standby quarterly.

kelly: Also, add fields to postmortem action items: 'remediation-id', 'owner', 'severity', 'regression-risk', 'due-date', 'blockers'. That makes filtering in the tracker much easier.

maya: Good call. My proposed pilot plan: week 0 — pilot with infra + API teams using the ownership grid, incident template updated; week 3 — gather feedback + tweak reminder cadence; week 6 — decide whether to expand. I'll own the pilot and run a 6-week retro.

jia: Can we automate owner pings? incident-bot could DM owners at 48h and 24h before due-date, and post weekly summaries to #eng-oncall. Also add a lightweight Confluence template link in the postmortem.

incident-bot: Reminder: watcher created for 'ownership-signal-grid' pilot. Automated pings (48h/24h) ready to enable. Ping @maya to add the Confluence template URL. :robot_face:

alex: :thumbsup: happy to volunteer as fallback for the first pilot rotation and help with calendar invites for the IC soft-standby schedule.

kelly: Also propose a retro checkpoint 1 month after pilot ends to look for recurring incident patterns and ownership friction.

maya: Thanks all — I'll update the postmortem template, add the grid to the tracker, and drop the pilot calendar invite. Action items: maya: create template & calendar; incident-bot: enable pings when maya adds template; alex: be fallback for pilot; kelly: add retro checkpoint. We'll reconvene in #eng-oncall next Monday for final sign-off. :eyes:
